= perf =
== event ==
	1. probe
		a) perf probe --add do_nanosleep
		b) perf record -e probe:do_nanosleep -a sleep 5
		c) perf script
		d) perf probe --del do_nanosleep
		
== 火焰图 ==
		a) perf record -F 99 -a -g -p 17518 -- sleep 5
		b) perf script > stacks1
		c) ./FlameGraph/stackcollapse-perf.pl perf.unfold &> perf.folded
		d) ./FlameGraph/flamegraph.pl perf.folded > perf.svg
== offcpu ==
		a) offcputime -K -f 10 > log
		b) ./FlameGraph/flamegraph.pl log > perf.svg
== pmu ==		
	a) sudo perf stat -e cpu/event=0xd3,umask=0x02,name=MEM_LOAD_L3_MISS_RETIRED.REMOTE_DRAM/,cpu/event=0xd3,umask=0x01,name=MEM_LOAD_L3_MISS_RETIRED.LOCAL_DRAM/,cpu-clock -p 1402279 -- sleep 3
